blocks.content: Introduction to STC and TSO replacement basics
Recognize STC meaning and TSO-for-TSO replacement reasoning.

items.definition: Replacing a TSO part with another TSO part of the same type, done per approved data, is generally NOT a major alteration — it does not change the type design in a way that appreciably affects airworthiness.
items.analogy: Like replacing a UL-listed circuit breaker with another of the same rating per the panel specs — same approval class, done per the approved design data.

items.definition: An FAA approval that permits modification of a type-certificated aircraft in a manner not covered by the original type certificate. The STC holder owns the approved data package for that specific modification.
items.analogy: Like an officially approved aftermarket upgrade — sanctioned by the certifying authority, covering exactly the modification specified and no more.

blocks.question: A technician replaces a TSO-approved comm radio with a different brand but same TSO class unit, per the aircraft manufacturer's approved data. This is classified as:
choices: A major alteration — any avionics change requires FAA Form 337
A major repair — comm systems are flight-critical installed equipment
Generally not a major alteration — it is a TSO-for-TSO replacement per approved data
Preventive maintenance — TSO equipment replacement is owner-authorized
blocks.feedback: TSO-for-TSO replacement per approved data is generally not a major alteration because it does not appreciably change the aircraft's airworthiness qualities. Both qualifiers matter: same TSO class and done per approved data.

blocks.question: What is an STC?
choices: A required FAA inspection interval for modified aircraft systems
An FAA approval authorizing modification of a type-certificated aircraft beyond its original type certificate
A document recording the completion of a major repair on an aircraft
A manufacturer's approval for using a parts substitute on a certificated aircraft
blocks.feedback: An STC is an FAA approval authorizing a specific modification to a specific aircraft type, including the approved data package. ADs mandate action. Form 337 documents work. PMA approves parts. Only an STC authorizes the original modification.
